title: Kinesiology, B.S. — Movement Science Option (College of Health and Human Development)
notes: Movement Science Option, University Park (of three: Applied Exercise and Health -- a PDE teacher-certification track needing SPLED 400/CI 280/student teaching, not modeled here -- Movement Science, and Exercise Science, which needs relocation off University Park). The KINES and NUTR department catalogs were already largely populated from earlier work; no new catalog files needed. Real bug avoided (learned from earlier majors this session): the bulletin's own Semester 1 math pick is 'MATH 26', but CHEM 110 (Semester 3) has a concurrent requirement recognizing only MATH 22/140/141, not MATH 26 -- substituted MATH 140 as the primary Semester 1 pick to avoid the mismatch. Explicitly scheduled ENGL 15 (Semester 1) and CAS 100A (Semester 3) rather than generic 'GWS' slots, since ENGL 202C/D later requires ENGL 15/30H specifically and a generic domain-slot pick isn't guaranteed to resolve to the right course. 'KINES 400-level' (elective, appears 3 times), 'Elective (graduate school prerequisite)' pools, and one capstone-writing course from '425W/430W/439W/447W/481W/492W/493W' (chose 425W, simplest prereq: KINES 100 only) are modeled generically/simply, matching CMPSC's own open-pool convention. Real prereq-fix fallout, two parts: (1) CHEM 110/106 now require MATH 22 (which itself requires MATH 21, MATH 4, and MATH 3 in turn -- the concurrent MATH 22/140/141 recognition mentioned above no longer exists in the current catalog, only a strict MATH 22 prereq) -- added all four remedial courses as explicit Semester 1-4 items. Dropped CHEM 130 from the CHEM item's option pool: CHEM 130 only needs MATH 21/32 so it was becoming eligible (and getting greedily picked) a full term before CHEM 110/106, which then stranded the downstream CHEM 112 requirement (CHEM 112 only accepts CHEM 106/110/110H, not CHEM 130). (2) Even after that fix, this major's original 17cr/semester cap left exactly one term too little slack to absorb the four extra remedial courses on top of the existing course load -- bumped the cap to 18cr/semester (still under PSU's 19cr flat-rate billing threshold, and the same cap already used by IE/IID/IEC elsewhere in this batch) to fit everything into 8 terms.

items.label: CHEM 110 (or 106 -- CHEM 130 dropped, it doesn't satisfy the downstream CHEM 112 prereq)
